The '''Massacre on the ''Star-Wake''''' was a skirmish between [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] and the crew of the ''[[Star-Wake]]''. Zannah had to find passage to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to meet her [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. After the ''Star-Wake'' took off, Zannah was pulling a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] out of a trunk when she was confronted by [[Tallo (Star-Wake)|Tallo]]. There was a scuffle and Tallo was shot. [[Bordon]] walked in on the [[Death/Legends|murder]] and he was killed next. Zannah went into the cockpit and killed [[Irtanna]] after she attempted to defuse the situation. [[Wend]] begged for his life, but the Sith shot him anyway. She dragged the bodies into the hold, set the ship on autopilot, and headed for [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
